verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a compliance SaaS that stores customer and transaction data, so the axis applies. The pack documents no retention settings and no way to delete data. Deleting client credentials to invalidate an API token (salv-docs-6) is an adjacent access control, not deletion of stored data, and on-premise deployment options are not retention controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
